title: LSP command Goto References causes a segfault on 4.6 Beta 3 (with NeoVim)
body:
### Tested versions

Crashes on:
v4.6.beta.custom_build [5d9722e83]
v4.6.beta3.official [76dda5c6c]

Not tested on v4.6.beta2.official [551ce8d47], see https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114401

Might not crash, but at least hangs the editor.
v4.6.beta1.official [d743736f8]
v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]


### System information

Godot v4.6.beta3 - Bazzite 43.20260101.0 (Kinoite) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (nvidia; 590.44.01) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 125.5 GiB memory

### Issue description

Goto References works ok with just a blank project and AClass and BClass (see below). If I add GDUnit4 and do the same I get a segmentation fault.

### Steps to reproduce

Test files:
```
class_name AClass extends Node

func test() -> void:
    print("test")
```

```
class_name BClass extends Node

var a: AClass # Put cursor on a and invoke Goto References

func _ready() -> void:
    a.test()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    a.test()

```

Add GDUnit as addon https://github.com/godot-gdunit-labs/gdUnit4/commit/c8d63a903b8be964b1564112abc18b95723bbb16.
